description: The figure presents two pie charts, labeled (a) and (b), illustrating the co-occurrence of the word "reaction" with various tokens in different domains. Chart (a), representing the domain of chemistry, shows five distinct categories: "the" (31%, light blue with diagonal stripes), "this" (21%, medium blue with horizontal stripes), "for" (17%, light green with crosshatch), "chemical" (15%, light green with dots), and "to" (9%, yellow with diagonal stripes), along with a small segment labeled "in" (7%, very light blue with vertical stripes). The legend for chart (a) is located above the chart, and percentage labels are displayed within each slice. Chart (b), representing the domain of mathematics, displays four categories: "the" (38%, medium blue with diagonal stripes), "$" (27%, pink with dots), "equilibrium" (19%, yellow with diagonal stripes), and "constatant" (15%, grey with dots). The legend for chart (b) is also above the chart, and percentage labels are shown within the slices. Both charts use distinct patterns and colors to differentiate the categories, with the largest segment in chart (a) being "the" and in chart (b) being "the" as well.
